meta.title: A second surrogate bid for the same vendor
gaps: Starting from the setup state of a live RFQ with no bids; the prepared state supplies an event with an existing bid and does not expose a way to reset it to no bids.
Guaranteeing that the first surrogate bid is placed for Vendor A and that the second attempt targets that same newly created surrogate bid rather than an existing prepared bid.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Starting from the setup state of a live RFQ with no bids; the prepared state supplies an event with an existing bid and does not expose a way to reset it to no bids.; Guaranteeing that the first surrogate bid is placed for Vendor A and that the second attempt targets that same newly created surrogate bid rather than an existing prepared bid.

steps.note: Open the prepared event's buyer-side Participants tab; the case concerns surrogate bidding there.
Attempt to create the first surrogate bid for the named vendor.
Verify that the first surrogate bid was accepted before testing the duplicate attempt.

args.because: A bid is already placed on behalf of this company.

steps.note: Attempt the second surrogate bid for the same vendor and require Procol's duplicate-bid refusal.
